title: REQ · Guard CLI script prints tracked paths and exits non-zero
summary: A tracked guard script runs checkTrackedFiles with a real git runner and exits 1 when anything is tracked.
description: Add runGuard(run, log) returning an exit code in the helper module and a script scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts that wires execFileSync git and process.exit. Why: npm test needs an executable gate.
acceptance_criteria: Given a runner listing a tracked node_modules path, When runGuard runs, Then it logs that path and returns 1.
Given a runner listing only source paths, When runGuard runs, Then it returns 0 and logs nothing offending.
Given the repo, When git ls-files lists the script, Then scripts/assertNoTrackedNodeModules.ts exists and is tracked.
technical_constraints: Script uses execFileSync from node:child_process like untrackNodeModules.ts
definition_of_done: Script file exists and is committed
